New installations now default to **`Planner/Entries`** and **`Planner/Threads`**, so the initial folder settings are in English regardless of Obsidian's language.

Updates preserve your existing saved folder settings. No existing files or folders are renamed or moved.

Validation: official Obsidian lint rules, strict TypeScript, fourteen model tests, build/package checks, central installation verification, and an in-app check that renders the English defaults while preserving the existing settings file byte for byte.

Requires Obsidian 1.10.2 or later. Download `main.js`, `manifest.json` and `styles.css` below and put them in the vault configuration directory under `plugins/just-simple-planner/`, then reload the plugin. GitHub Actions builds, checks, attests and publishes all three files.
